remarks: Discover the possibilities in Montrose Estates, Beaumont. This 702.35 m² pie-shaped partially fenced lot sits in a quiet cul-de-sac, with a northeast-facing front and a southwest-facing backyard. Choose your builder and create a home that suits your needs. Schools, parks, and a pond are within walking distance, while shopping, everyday amenities, the Beaumont Aqua-Fit Centre, and the recreation centre are just minutes away. (id:67522)
